findings.comment: `__filename` is defined using `fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)` along with the `fileURLToPath` import, but neither is ever used in the script.
Comments are written in Turkish while the rest of the codebase and file comments use English.

By default, `GITHUB_TOKEN` only has read permissions in modern GitHub repositories unless explicitly granted write permissions. Step `git push` on line 92 will fail with 403 Forbidden without `contents: write` permission declared on the job or workflow.

`actions/checkout@v3` (and later) defaults to `fetch-depth: 1`, creating a shallow clone. Pushing commits directly back to the branch from a shallow clone without fetching or checking out the branch ref can result in push rejection or history divergence.

Inconsistent language codes are used: `workflow_dispatch.inputs.languages.default` defaults to `tr,en` and `download-translations.js` defaults to `tr,en`, but the fallback in line 60 uses `'tr,gb'` (which is also mentioned in the README). When scheduled via cron, `github.event.inputs.languages` will be empty, triggering `tr,gb` instead of `tr,en`.
